name: Reachy Mini
description: Bridge between OpenClaw messaging channels and Reachy Mini robot. Forward messages to the robot, receive transcripts back.

reachyUrl.description: Base URL of the Reachy bridge API (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8100)

apiSecret.description: Shared secret for bridge API auth (must match REACHY_BRIDGE_SECRET)

forwardMessages.description: Forward incoming messages to the robot

transcriptChannels.description: Channels to forward robot transcripts to (e.g. ['telegram:123456'])

extractLinks.description: Fetch and inject link content (two-phase injection)

linkMaxChars.description: Max characters to extract from links
